title: Handley Page Halifax LW598
memorial_details: description: Single-stepped rectangular base surmounted by a rectangular sectioned marble pillar incorporating a sloping top face on which is mounted an engraved bronze plaque. At the top of the plaque is a Halifax bomber design with names and inscription below. A single-line border, scalloped at each corner, encloses the aircraft design, names and inscription and all are infilled with white paint. The whole memorial is enclosed by gravel within a kerbed area.
